class ChatChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def speak(data)
    workspace = Workspace.find(params[:workspace_id])
    html = ApplicationController.render(
      partial: "chats/message",
      locals: {message: data["message"], user:}
    )

    broadcast_to(
      workspace,
      action: "newMessage",
      html:,
      author_id: user.id
    )
  end
end
